mapScope: Nacht der Untoten / BO3 Zombies Chronicles prototype weapon table

runtimeSemantics.identityMapping: load_weapon_spec_from_table() registers base weapon and upgrade_name; add_zombie_weapon() stores level.zombie_weapons[base].upgrade; get_upgrade_weapon() returns that upgrade identity.
runtimeSemantics.attachments: Attachment selection is independent of upgrade identity. Current source dump exposes exact attachmentmappingstable rows for a subset only.
runtimeSemantics.repeatedPackAPunch: can_upgrade_weapon() may allow an already-upgraded weapon only when attachment swapping is enabled and the weapon supports attachments.
runtimeSemantics.aat: weapon_supports_aat() requires an upgraded weapon and rejects AAT-exempt weapons.
runtimeSemantics.safetyRule: Do not synthesize upgraded ballistic damage/ammo from base weapon values. Keep gameplay stats pending until source-backed values are recovered.
runtimeSemantics.nativeIdentityRegistry: 35 dedicated IDs in reserved PaP range plus existing cymbal_monkey_upgraded catalog ID; registry reservation does not imply gameplay readiness.
